en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from the one who mentioned it, from Safwan Bin Yahya who said,

‘When Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> passed away and Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> spoke fearfully upon it (the Imamate) from that, so it was said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘You<sup>asws</sup> have manifested a great matter, and we fear upon you<sup>asws</sup> of this tyrant’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Let him strive his striving, but there would not be a way for him upon me<sup>asws</sup>’.
